items.q: What does the software development lifecycle (SDLC) management service cover?
items.a: DevTools covers everything from the conceptual phase (Discovery, specification definition and architecture), through agile development in sprints, QA and automated deployments, to full ownership transfer and evolutionary maintenance.

items.q: Who owns the source code and intellectual property?
items.a: 100% your company. GitHub/GitLab repositories are set up under your company's organization from day one. We sign full intellectual property assignment agreements with no retained rights or hidden licenses.

items.q: How long does a typical project take?
items.a: A complete MVP with a rigorous specification takes between 4 and 6 weeks. Enterprise SaaS projects or ecosystems with mobile apps usually take between 8 and 12 weeks, with staging deliverables every 14 days.

items.q: Which technologies and stacks do you use?
items.a: We specialize in high-performance stacks and modern ecosystems: Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, Node.js / NestJS, Python (FastAPI), React Native, Flutter, PostgreSQL and managed Cloud services on AWS and Google Cloud.

items.q: Do you offer a warranty and support after launch?
items.a: Yes. Every delivery includes a 30-day full warranty at no cost for bug fixes or minor adjustments. We also offer monthly support plans (Retainer SLA) for continuous evolution.
